day_ahead_price_eur_mwh.description: Hourly German Day-Ahead wholesale electricity spot price (EPEX SPOT DE-LU).

is_negative_price.description: Binary indicator for negative spot price occurrence (day_ahead_price_eur_mwh < 0.00).

price_lag_24h.leakage_rationale: Settled Day-Ahead price of same delivery hour yesterday (D-1). Published and known prior to gate closure for day D.

price_lag_48h.leakage_rationale: Settled price from D-2. Fully settled and cleared prior to auction gate closure.

price_lag_72h.leakage_rationale: Settled price from D-3. Fully historical.

price_lag_96h.leakage_rationale: Settled price from D-4. Fully historical.

price_lag_120h.leakage_rationale: Settled price from D-5. Fully historical.

price_lag_144h.leakage_rationale: Settled price from D-6. Fully historical.

price_lag_168h.leakage_rationale: Settled price of same delivery hour same day last week (D-7). Captures weekly cyclicality.

price_daily_lag_mean_7d.transformation: Row-wise mean across the 7 historical daily lag columns
price_daily_lag_mean_7d.leakage_rationale: Computed strictly from historical daily lags. Never includes current delivery day target.

price_daily_lag_std_7d.transformation: Row-wise sample standard deviation across the 7 historical daily lag columns
price_daily_lag_std_7d.leakage_rationale: Captures recent price volatility across historical daily lags without target contamination.

load_actual_lag_48h.leakage_rationale: Actual total electrical load from D-2. Minimum 48h lag respects SMARD retrospective publication latency.

load_actual_lag_168h.leakage_rationale: Actual total electrical load from same hour last week (D-7). Fully historical and settled.

hour_of_day.leakage_rationale: Deterministic delivery hour known infinitely in advance.

hour_sin.leakage_rationale: Trigonometric encoding of diurnal delivery cycle.

hour_cos.leakage_rationale: Trigonometric encoding of diurnal delivery cycle.

day_of_week.leakage_rationale: Deterministic calendar property known in advance.

is_dst.transformation: Binary indicator for Daylight Saving Time (1 for CEST, 0 for CET)
is_dst.leakage_rationale: Deterministic legal clock regime in Europe/Berlin.

is_public_holiday_de.transformation: Binary indicator for statutory German nationwide public holidays
is_public_holiday_de.leakage_rationale: Fixed legal calendar dates known years in advance.

is_bridge_day.transformation: Binary indicator for Friday following a Thursday holiday or Monday preceding a Tuesday holiday
is_bridge_day.leakage_rationale: Deterministic calendar rule. Strongly correlates with German industrial shutdown leave.

solar_elevation_proxy.leakage_rationale: Exact astronomical solar position calculated for geographic center of Germany. 100% deterministic, zero weather data, zero lookahead.

load_forecast_mw.transformation: Raw SMARD Filter 411 total load forecast
load_forecast_mw.lookback: Published by 12:00 CET on D-1 per EU Regulation 543/2013
load_forecast_mw.leakage_rationale: PRE-AUCTION BY PUBLICATION RULE / ARCHIVE-VINTAGE NOT GUARANTEED. Retrospective SMARD archive may reflect updated load forecast vintages rather than strictly preserved point-in-time pre-auction bids.

load_forecast_diff_24h.leakage_rationale: PRE-AUCTION BY PUBLICATION RULE / ARCHIVE-VINTAGE NOT GUARANTEED. Day-over-day shift in forecasted system demand.

load_forecast_daily_peak_ratio.lookback: Published by 12:00 CET on D-1 for all 24h of day D
load_forecast_daily_peak_ratio.leakage_rationale: PRE-AUCTION BY PUBLICATION RULE / ARCHIVE-VINTAGE NOT GUARANTEED. Normalizes intraday demand shape relative to expected peak.
